## What is Subhalo?

**Subhalo** is a Cloud-9 research repository bridging:

1. **TNG Subhalo Validation** — Pull, filter, and compute Assembly Index scores for dark matter halos using the IllustrisTNG API.
2. **Quantum Sensing & Computing** — Formal entries for ion-trap spectroscopy, entanglement gates, BEC analog gravity, and quantum bridge integration.
3. **Stellar Astrophysics** — Observational entries for red supergiants, multi-wavelength galaxy galleries, and black-hole feedback.
4. **Critical Thresholds & Resilience** — Philosophical and complexity-science frameworks for understanding phase transitions, structural failure, and the "Purity Paradox" across physical and social systems.
5. **Evidence Framework Documentation** — Auditable entry schemas with multi-agent hypothesis debate (ADVOCATE/SKEPTIC/EVIDENCE/SYNTHESIZER) for evaluating claims from established cosmology (L1) to unfalsified anomalous phenomena (L2/L3).
6. **Bus Integration** — JSON-serialized outputs compatible with the C9 event bus (`c9_bus.jsonl`) for ingestion by the Oracle, Librarian, Hypothesis Debate, and Quantum Bridge modules.

## Hypothesis Debate Module Results

**Verdict: QUARANTINED to Layer 3** (score: 0.45)
- **SKEPTIC wins.** Source is truncated behind Medium paywall. No preprint, no peer review, no arXiv ID. Popular-science framing of extraordinary claim without accessible primary source is epistemically toxic.

### PHIL-001 — Physics of the Breaking Point
**Verdict: MAINTAIN Layer 2** (score: 0.58)
- **ADVOCATE/SYNTHESIZER consensus.** Explicit risk disclosure and conceptual value for C9 AI governance and resilience engineering. However, metaphorical extension from physics to politics requires formalization.
- **Action:** Formalize "Purity Paradox" as agent-based model with heterogeneity parameter. 90-day review.

### UAP-001 — UAP Materials Framework

- **ADVOCATE wins on methodology.** Isotope fingerprinting and bio-chirality assays are rigorous L1. SKEPTIC correctly flags conditional-premise risk but overstates it — frameworks have value independent of trigger frequency.
- **Action:** 12-month review. If no materials released by Aug 2027, demote existence-premise to L3; retain methodology as L1 standalone.

entries.title: NASA Chandra X-ray Observatory: 16 Galactic Gems Multi-Wavelength Gallery
entries.author: NASA / Chandra X-ray Center / Lydia Amazouz (Daily Galaxy)
key_claims: Multi-wavelength composite gallery of 16 galaxies combining Chandra X-ray, JWST, Hubble, IXPE, Swift, NuSTAR, and ground-based data
Images reveal supermassive black hole jets (Centaurus A, M106), superwinds (NGC 4631, M82), collisional ring structures (Arp 143), and polar rings (NGC 660)
X-ray data traces million-degree gas, energetic particles, and supernova remnants invisible to optical telescopes
Collection demonstrates galaxy lifecycle: star formation, internal bar-driven inflow, black-hole feedback, mergers, and environmental stripping (M90 in Virgo Cluster)
entries.methodology: Archival multi-mission data fusion; X-ray/optical/IR/radio image registration and color-composite rendering; public science communication
entries.key_risk: Gallery is observational showcase rather than new discovery publication. Scientific conclusions are syntheses of previously published data. No novel quantitative analysis presented.
entries.next_experiment: Cross-reference gallery sources with TNG100-1 simulated analogs (e.g., M82 superwind vs. TNG feedback models; Arp 143 merger vs. TNG merger trees); use as public-facing validation of C9 A_c visual complexity metrics
entries.notes: Pedagogical and public-engagement value is high. Scientific value lies in multi-mission data synthesis. Ideal for C9 outreach layer and for training visual complexity classifiers on real astronomical morphologies.

entries.title: ALMA Submillimeter Imaging of Betelgeuse Reveals Persistent Northeastern Hotspot and Corrugated Atmosphere
entries.author: Bill Dent et al. / ALMA (ESO/NAOJ/NRAO)
key_claims: ALMA extended-configuration observations (7 mas resolution, 16 km baseline) resolve submillimeter 'surface' of Betelgeuse at ~2,300 K
Northeastern hotspot persists for ≥7.3 years (2015–2023), far exceeding predicted convective cell lifetimes (months to few years)
Stellar radius deviates ±6% from circular; corrugated edge and molecular atmosphere (SiO, CO) show significant changes between epochs
Detached gas clump at ~10 km/s may connect to 2019–2020 Great Dimming event; companion star Betelgeuse B orbital axis aligns with hotspot geometry
If 2008/2015/2023 bright structures are same phenomenon, persistence approaches two decades
entries.methodology: ALMA Band 6/7 submillimeter interferometry in extended configuration (16 km baselines); 2015 and 2023 epoch comparison; molecular line imaging (SiO, CO); astrometric alignment to <2 mas
entries.key_risk: Companion-causation hypothesis is speculative; two-epoch data insufficient to securely link detached clump to Great Dimming; long-term hotspot persistence across 2008/2015/2023 not yet rigorously established as same structure
entries.next_experiment: Third-epoch ALMA observation (2026/2027) to confirm hotspot persistence and measure proper motion; VLTI/GRAVITY companion orbit refinement; 3D radiation-hydrodynamic simulations incorporating companion tides and magnetic fields
entries.notes: Excellent observational astrophysics. The persistent hotspot challenges standard convection models — a classic case where dominant theoretical paradigm (pure convection) may need revision. Companion-induced tidal locking or polar convection preference are alternative hypotheses. Directly relevant to C9 stellar-evolution complexity metrics.

entries.title: MitoMatch: AlphaFold-Multimer Prediction of Mitochondrial Protein Interaction Networks
entries.author: Tibi Puiu reporting on Nature Communications study
key_claims: AlphaFold-Multimer adapted to screen 630,003 possible protein pairs across human mitochondrial proteome (~1,123 proteins)
2,895 high-confidence interactions predicted at ~85% precision threshold; 57% were absent from six major interaction databases
85 previously uncharacterized mitochondrial proteins assigned potential partners and functional hypotheses
COA4-COX11 binding predicted by MitoMatch and validated experimentally in yeast and human cells; COA4 deletion reduces COX11 levels, mitochondrial copper, and respiratory complex IV abundance
entries.methodology: AlphaFold-Multimer complex prediction; threshold calibration against 1,338 known positives and 15,000 known negatives; experimental validation via co-immunoprecipitation and gene deletion in human cell lines
entries.key_risk: Computational predictions require experimental confirmation at scale; false positives remain possible outside the calibrated mitochondrial compartment where encounter probability is higher
entries.next_experiment: Expand to whole-proteome screening with evolutionary co-conservation filtering (cf. Predictomes 2025); integrate with C9 neuromorphic protein-interaction graph for active-inference modeling of metabolic networks
entries.notes: Excellent example of L1 AI-driven biology. The 'structure-to-function' pipeline parallels C9's own 'data-to-insight' Assembly Index workflow. Cross-species conservation analysis (11 organisms) adds evolutionary robustness.

entries.title: Spatiotemporal-Switchable 2D NIR-II Single-Atom Nanozyme for Single-Cell-Level Surgical Navigation and Glioblastoma Phototherapy
entries.author: Ping Shangguan et al. / Bingyang Shi group, UTS & Harvard
key_claims: 2D single-atom nanozyme platform provides dual-function intraoperative NIR-II imaging (44-micrometer resolution) and postoperative phototherapy for glioblastoma
Platinum atoms catalyze H2O2-to-O2 conversion, countering hypoxic tumor microenvironment; simultaneous photothermal/photodynamic therapy destroys residual microscopic cancer cells
In mouse glioblastoma models: 100% survival at 60 days vs. 42 days for surgery-only controls; no detectable neurological or motor impairments
Targeting molecule enables blood-brain barrier crossing and glioma-specific accumulation
entries.methodology: 2D nanosheet synthesis via semiconductor-adapted atomic placement; NIR-II fluorescent dye conjugation; in vivo mouse glioblastoma xenograft model; survival analysis; histological and behavioral assessment
entries.key_risk: Mouse models only — human translation uncertain. Blood-brain barrier penetration at human scale unproven. Long-term toxicity and immune response not assessed. Scale-up manufacturing of atomically precise 2D sheets is non-trivial.
entries.next_experiment: Primate BBB penetration studies; GLP toxicology; Phase I human trial in recurrent glioblastoma; integrate with C9 physical sensor layer for real-time nanoparticle tracking via NIR-II imaging
entries.notes: Strong translational medicine entry. The 'image then treat' spatiotemporal switching is a concrete realization of active inference (sense → update → act). Connects to C9 physical sensor layer and neuromorphic control loops.

entries.title: The Physics Of The Breaking Point: Critical Thresholds Across Quantum, Material, and Social Systems
entries.author: Unknown / Essay (Medium-style long-form)
key_claims: Phase transitions and critical thresholds are universal patterns across physical, biological, cognitive, and political systems
The 'Process-Pattern Trade': zoomed-in observation reveals indeterminate process; zoomed-out reveals rigid pattern; the snap is their collision
The Purity Paradox: systems that eliminate 'weak' or marginal elements appear stronger but become more brittle due to lost redundancy and shock absorption
Totalitarian regimes engineer their own collapse by converting flexible social complexity into rigid monoculture — a structural, not merely political, failure
Resilience requires designing for slack, diversity, friction, and the inclusion of vulnerability — across scales from quantum to social
entries.methodology: Philosophical essay synthesizing concepts from statistical mechanics (phase transitions), quantum mechanics (observer effect), materials science (brittle vs. ductile failure), and political history. No formal quantitative methods. Uses analogy and structural isomorphism as primary reasoning tools.
entries.key_risk: Heavy reliance on metaphorical extension from physics to social systems. Historical examples are selective and anecdotal rather than systematically tested. The 'Purity Paradox' is a compelling conceptual frame but lacks empirical validation across regime types. Risk of confirmation bias in historical case selection.
entries.next_experiment: Formalize Purity Paradox as testable hypothesis: quantify redundancy/diversity metrics in political systems and correlate with collapse probability using political science datasets (Polity IV, V-Dem). Test quantum phase transition → social system analogy via agent-based models with tunable heterogeneity parameters.
entries.notes: L2 philosophical synthesis. The quantum phase transition and glacier mechanics sections are grounded in real physics (L1), but the extension to political regimes is analogical rather than deductive. The 'Process-Pattern Trade' is an epistemological insight that resonates with C9's multi-resolution Assembly Index formalism. The Purity Paradox directly challenges optimization-for-efficiency paradigms in AI governance (Cluster 6) and social design. Cross-references well with COSMO-005 (finite observability as a kind of horizon/snap) and ASTRO-002 (persistent structure in dynamic system).

entries.title: Infrared Absorption Spectroscopy of a Single Polyatomic Molecular Ion via Quantum Logic
entries.author: Zhenlin Wu et al. / Philipp Schindler group, University of Innsbruck
key_claims: Quantum logic spectroscopy enables non-destructive IR absorption measurement of a single CaOH+ molecular ion
Schrödinger's cat entangled state between molecular ion and auxiliary atomic ion amplifies imperceptible photon recoil into measurable signal
O-H stretching vibration spectrum of singly-charged calcium hydroxide matches theoretical predictions from University of Warsaw collaborators
Method is generalizable to diverse molecular species for quantum-state preparation and precision spectroscopy
entries.methodology: Trapped two-ion mixed-species crystal; quantum logic operations; entangled cat-state detection of single-photon recoil; comparison with ab initio theory
entries.key_risk: None significant. Method validated against theory. Generalizability to larger polyatomic molecules remains to be demonstrated.
entries.next_experiment: Extend to larger astrophysically relevant molecules (e.g., PAHs, metal hydrides) for laboratory astrochemistry; integrate with QPilotos quantum bridge for automated ion-trap control
entries.notes: Landmark L1 result. Directly connects to C9 Quantum Bridge v2.0 (ion-trap backends) and Cluster 3 (quantum information). The 'cat-state amplification' principle mirrors the signal-boost logic used in C9 SNN focality metrics.

entries.title: Robust Two-Qubit Geometric Phase Gates Using Amplitude and Frequency Ramping in Trapped Ions
entries.author: C. M. Bowers et al. / LLNL & NIST Ion Storage Group
key_claims: Ramped detuning and amplitude modulation of state-dependent forces enable robust trapped-ion two-qubit geometric phase gates
Gate protocol captures robustness of far-detuned operation while retaining speed from near-resonant phases
Ions operate at higher temperatures with reduced calibration overhead, paving way for scalable ion-trap quantum computers
Phase-space trajectory control ensures motional state returns to origin, leaving only entangling phase shift

entries.next_experiment: Implement in shielded multi-zone trap with extra hardware; benchmark gate fidelity at scale; integrate with QPilotos router for distributed ion-trap quantum networking
